description:
`fetch_reddit_api` (reddit.cr:120) already takes `api_base` as a parameter with default `REDDIT_API_BASE`. `fetch_old_reddit` (reddit.cr:163) is a thin wrapper that calls it with `OLD_REDDIT_API_BASE` and `with_retry_max_retries(2)`:

```crystal
private def self.fetch_old_reddit(...) : Result
  old_config = config.with_retry_max_retries(2)
  Fetcher.with_retry(old_config) do
    fetch_reddit_api(subreddit, sort, limit, headers, old_config, OLD_REDDIT_API_BASE)
  end
end
```

Both use `Fetcher.with_retry` (the main path inside `fetch_fallback`, the old path inside `fetch_old_reddit`). The wrapper adds no observable behavior beyond passing a different base + retry count.

Action: drop `fetch_old_reddit` and inline its call site in `fetch_fallback` with the explicit retry config + base. Alternatively, keep the name as a 2-liner that captures only the config difference. Either way, eliminate the duplicated header setup path.

Acceptance: behavior unchanged (same retry counts, same headers, same fallback order), no duplicated code paths, specs pass.
title: Consolidate duplicate fetch_reddit_api and fetch_old_reddit
